protocol.rationale: Prior initial-rollout critic/actor gradient ratio was 18-28 at lambda=.95; multiplying vf_coef by .1 tests reducing this imbalance without changing target rewards, GAE, or clipping rule.
protocol.primary: Paired deterministic D at 10,240: all seeds, mean/median differences; descriptive only.
protocol.secondary: Linear equal cost, five costs, reliability, violation, action share; sampling diagnostic only.
protocol.mechanism: Critic-weighted gradient, global clipping frequency, actor/critic parameter deltas, GAE/value/return statistics.
protocol.fixed: lambda=.95, gamma=1, global clip max=.5, all PPO settings except vf_coef; same initial policy, JAR, physics, trace payloads and budget.
protocol.namespace: pilot_train and pilot_validation only; no confirmatory/test access.
protocol.decision_rule: No automatic adoption or seed selection; report all results. No significance/superiority claim. Do not proceed to P08 in this batch.
protocol.prefix_scope: 10,240 vs 10,752 pilot only; no F checkpoint reuse claim for vf_coef=.05.
protocol.config_separation: Immutable simulator config/JAR and separately hashed full effective learner config.
